title: The Detention of Westbrook High
author: Petra Sandoval
blurb: Tamsin Lockridge, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must save the tradition that made the town before the final audition.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
